# Personal

I am Alvaro Gavilán-Rojas, a civil structural engineer (2021) born in 1995 in Asunción, Paraguay. I live in Rennes, France, where I did my PhD (2025) in computational mechanics. I started this personal website to share posts about:

- Structural mechanics
- Scientific programming with [Julia](https://julialang.org/)
- Reproducible documents with [Quarto](https://quarto.org)

I have a [YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/@alvaro_gavilan_rojas) where I upload content on these topics and guitar music.


# Website

I develop and maintain the code for this website using [Quarto](https://quarto.org). Hosting is provided by [Github Pages](https://docs.github.com/en/pages) and DNS is provided by [Squarespace](https://squarespace.com).
